notes: Summary: Halcyon is evaluating a Private (VPC) deployment to host sensitive transaction-support assistants and embeddings for compliance search. Primary procurement driver is auditable, exportable audit logs + customer-managed keys. Key asks: 1) SIEM export paths (Splunk/Datadog/Elastic) via secure forwarder; support for syslog/HTTPS with mutual-TLS; ability to push JSON and CEF formats. 2) Canonical log schema — want fields: timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, principal_id (pseudonymized), model, model_version, route, prompt_hash, response_hash, token_count_in, token_count_out, latency_ms, status_code, host/pod_id, region, client_ip (CIDR or masked), audit_action. Must be able to include redaction markers for PII removals. 3) Retention policy — SOC requires 7 years for audit trail metadata for transactional workflows; access logs (proxy/access) 1 year; debug/full payload logs kept only for 90 days and require explicit approval. Need WORM/immutable storage option for audit trail. 4) KMS integration — external key support (BYOK), HSM-backed keys, envelope encryption, key rotation policy and rotation proof artifacts, support for key import/export constraints. 5) Access controls & telemetry — SSO (SAML), fine-grained RBAC, admin audit trails, and ability to export audit logs to customer SIEM daily and on-demand. POC asks: demonstrate log shipping to customer Splunk with provided index mapping; show KMS BYOK flow with a sample key, prove that model cache artifacts are encrypted (metadata only), and validate that enabling audit logging adds <10% median latency overhead in our perf tests. Notes from SOC: "must see sample log files mapped to our Splunk sourcetypes; prefer CEF for legacy; JSON ok if mapping provided." Legal concerns: key escrow and term-end key destruction wording. Pricing: leaning toward a 12-month private deployment commit if security gating items are satisfied. Next deliverables: SIEM mapping doc (this week), KMS integration runbook + sample encrypted artifact, POC plan with perf targets and success criteria.
